name: doc_id
description: Document ID, e.g. RB-CAR-003

name: version
description: Document version; postmortems are version 1

name: status
description: current | superseded. Only current documents are evidence

name: doc_type
description: runbook | postmortem

name: title
description: Document title

name: file_path
description: Path under data/docs/ and under the bucket's docs prefix

name: media
description: pdf_text (has a text layer) | pdf_scan (image only, needs OCR)

name: exception_type
description: inventory_shortage, allocation, carrier_delay, payment_hold, warehouse_disruption or recent_change

name: owner
description: Owning team (runbooks)

name: effective_date
description: Runbooks: when this version took effect

name: supersedes
description: Runbooks: the version this one replaced

name: superseded_by
description: Runbooks: the version that replaced this one

name: superseded_date
description: Runbooks: when this version stopped being current

name: incident_date
description: Postmortems: date of the incident

name: warehouse_id
description: Warehouse the document is about, if one

name: carrier
description: Carrier the document is about, if one

name: region
description: Region (postmortems)

name: root_cause_category
description: Postmortems: root-cause category

name: severity
description: Postmortems: SEV level

name: duration_hours
description: Postmortems: incident duration
